params.prompt: Edit the supplied isolated ABOUT floating island. Keep studio house, viewpoint, island placement and proportions. Replace overgrown vegetation: ONE elegant light-barked deciduous tree with airy irregular small pointed leaves and open visible branching, sunlit meadow with low grass and a few tiny wildflowers. Warm daylight, natural fine texture, softly stylized premium 3D. IMPORTANT remove waterfalls completely: dry bare stone where the old waterfalls were; only small turquoise spring lips at x=30% y=43% and x=74% y=46% of image.
